files.summary: Normative boot spec (BOOT-01..14 plus Plotinium IDs SVC-01..18). Contents: the six stages with thread, work, screen and failure behaviour. POST capability matrix: an insecure context is fatal because Web Locks and crypto.subtle are secure-context-only (MDN cited). One read-only boot-volume read in the kernel at stage 2; it uses indexedDB.databases() first, because open() without a version creates an empty v1 database. The desktop-interactive definition. The Valibot ServiceManifestSchema, which keeps the spec's 7 fields and adds optional extensions. All 18 C17 manifests (30 edges, 7 levels) with a Mermaid level diagram, validation rules V1-V10 and a proof that the boot closure A is all-critical. A completion-driven Kahn start with timeouts on the kernel timer heap, degraded/blocked/retry-wait states with equal-jitter back-off, a service state machine, and the critical-failure recovery screen. Normal, Safe, Recovery and Verbose modes; Safe and Recovery use the built-in manifests, so [S] always escapes a cycle. The recovery console commands and a 15 s stall watchdog. Cycle panic text and the examiner test (svcctl require auth lockd reproduces the spec's auth/sync/lockd cycle). The truthful progress formula in two-part monotone form, equal to the strategy formula for default manifests, using decoded asset sizes, with a static timer check allowing exactly two progress-free timers. Boot budget with warm, cold and cold-first definitions and pilot figures labelled. BootRecord schema and the --critical-path algorithm with a proof and sample output. Graceful shutdown (checkpoint before SIGTERM, reverse-topological stop) plus the visibilitychange/pagehide path. BOOT-13 accessibility; the /bin/<app>.json application start-up DAG in sys.spawn with an errno mapping; stage-6 prefetch. A test table mapping every BOOT and SVC ID to a titled test.

Normative DSA spec, with structures S1-S12 numbered the same way in every section. Covers the first-principles rule (no external imports, lint-enforced; pilot code never imported; AI disclosure; no temporary library substitutes) and the IMPLEMENTED-flag convention (describe.runIf gating, coverage include/exclude from tools/dsa-status.ts, per-gate tag check with implement-by weeks). Inventory with owners, non-owner reviewers and users, plus a usage diagram. Per structure: purpose and §10.1 location, TypeScript interface compatible with the §10.3 sketches, memory layout, invariants, complexity proofs, edge cases and the errno mapping. The structures: n-ary tree with O(1) move by re-parenting; struct-of-arrays radix trie with cmd/path/flag/hist namespaces, per-directory path keys, the radix-vs-one-char justification (pilot 493 MB vs 24 MB, labelled), a worked example and a proof that completion is independent of n; indexed binary min-heap with a key-exactness proof, BoundedTopK and a PriorityQueue facade; DAG with CSR, Kahn levels, deterministic cycle-path extraction, completion cursor, reverse graph and ancestors; LRU with pinned entries unlinked for O(1) evict, putAtLru and moveToLru; open-addressing IntHashTable (Fibonacci hash, backward-shift delete with a reachability proof, load ≤ 0.5) shared by PidTable and the window registry; ring buffer variants; double-hashing Bloom filter matching the RAG spec; z-order list with 1..n renumbering; optional interval tree with a justification rule; pointers to the database B-tree/hash indexes; documented Map/Set registries. Also: benchmark method (n = 10^3/10^4/10^5, ns/op and bytes/entry, shape assertions, hard limits SYS-03 p95 ≤ 1 ms and ≤ 32 MB at 10^5), JSON reporting schema, the DSA.md entry template with per-structure skeleton rows, and exhaustive edge-case, property (fast-check) and benchmark test titles.

cross_spec_requests: 01-architecture/architecture.md: change the §6 row 'Not a secure context → degraded' to fatal (Unsupported screen). Web Locks (ARC-02) and crypto.subtle (MEM-03, OFF-03) are secure-context-only. The ARC-07 shadow-installation point you asked for is answered in boot spec §3.14 (after kernel.ready, before the first app view chunk import).

01-architecture/syscall-abi.md: add bootlog, svc.status, svc.restart, svc.verify, boot.setFlags, shutdown and reboot with the args, permissions and errnos of boot spec §4.7 and §6.2 (shutdown/reboot limited to uid 0 or the console login uid; agent gets EPERM). Add spawn errno detail fields for the app start-up DAG: ENOENT missing manifest, EINVAL cycle, ENOSYS service skipped or permanently failed, EAGAIN service starting or shutting down. Add the router-port boot messages of boot spec §4.5.

03-kernel/processes-and-scheduling.md: expose the kernel timer heap as KernelTimers {at, cancel, now}, created in kernel init before the sched service. Add PCB kind 'service' (ppid 1, uid 0) for started services. spawn calls the app start-up DAG resolver before placement. 2 s SIGTERM grace at shutdown. Keep ready-heap seq < 2^32 and renumber before wrap-around. The timer module runs same-deadline entries in priority order (the heap does not break ties). PidTable is IntHashTable<PCB> from dsa/hashtable.

03-kernel/memory-and-paging.md: provide mm.checkpointAll({reason}) for shutdown step 2 and visibilitychange→hidden, returning (pid, page_ids) per window process for the session layout. Use dsa/lru putAtLru for speculative pages and moveToLru for minimised-window pages, and specify the victim order across them. Report the kernel baseline from each structure's stats().

04-vfs/virtual-file-system.md: make the children of /system/services and /system/log device-local (SVC-08). Implement /system/log/boot.log as a kernel-synthesised read-only file backed by the bootlog store. Recovery-mode fsck --repair makes local-only repairs with no outbox ops. Add IndexedDB meta keys bootFlags, bootSeq, fencingEpoch, schemaVersion and the bootlog store (key bootId). Seed /bin/*.json and /bin/lib/*.json at mkfs. Forbid U+0000 in names. Decide EBUSY vs EINVAL for operations on '/'. Emit vfs.* events with (dirIno, name) so the completion trie updates incrementally.

06-sync/offline-and-sync.md: exclude device-local subtrees from the outbox, snapshots and the per-owner feed. sync.start() resolves 'degraded' (self-healing) when offline and reports reconnect attempts through ctx.backoff. sync.stop() flushes the outbox, waiting ≤ 3 s for acks.

09-database/database.md: the server seed creates the /system/services and /system/log directory inodes (well-known ids) but no children, and the op pipeline rejects ops under them with EPERM. Keep the index list with before/after EXPLAIN evidence in a form DSA.md can link per index.

05-wm/window-manager.md: in Safe mode, session restore paints frames with a 'Not started (safe mode)' placeholder. Define the compositor handshake that marks the wm service started, and confirm the desktop-interactive definition (rAF plus MessageChannel after mount). The window registry is dsa/hashtable and the stacking order is dsa/zorder; write z-index only for returned ZChanges. Decide by W13 whether the interval tree is used for snap targets.
05-wm/ui-design-system.md: tokens for the boot bar (--pl-motion-fast width transition; 0 ms under reduced motion) and for the panic, recovery, stall, unsupported and shutdown screens in both themes.

07-shell/shell-and-terminal.md: wire bootlog, shutdown, reboot and svcctl (owned by R5); in Safe mode, ai, semsearch and predict print 'unavailable in safe mode'. The complete query path answers path completions only after the kernel checks r on the directory and x on its ancestors; hist completions use the caller uid from the port; complete --bench prints the SYS-03 p95.

10-ai/predictive-prefetch.md: provide ai.predict.top({k}) for stage-6 pre-fetch by the session service. prefetch:* warms the whole app start-up closure. The telemetry ring is dsa/ringbuffer with capacity 4,096 and slotOf for the IndexedDB mirror.

10-ai/rag-semantic-search.md: the dsa/bloom interface matches your request (add, mayContain, rebuild), with m rounded up to a multiple of 32. Top-K' uses dsa/heap BoundedTopK (replaceTop). The indexer queue key is classRank·2^40 + enqueuedAt in monotonic ms since t0; epoch ms would overflow 2^40.
11-server/backend-api.md: the lease-expiry heap is dsa/heap (renewals via changePriority); rate-limit keys are bounded by dsa/lru in bounded mode.

12-security/security-model.md: record the recovery console's no-login trust model (it can only check, repair or clear the local mirror and reset the local session), the /version.json foreign-server check, and the shutdown/reboot permission rule.

13-quality/testing-and-performance.md: add the boot budgets of boot spec §7 and the DSA shape assertions and hard limits (SYS-03 p95 ≤ 1 ms; ≤ 32 MB at 10^5) to budgets.json. Add tools/check-boot-truth.ts, the dsa/no-external-imports lint rule and fixture, coverage driven by tools/dsa-status.ts, and the warm, cold and cold-first boot scenarios to the nightly lab run.

14-devops/deployment-and-ci.md: add a Vite plugin emitting boot-manifest.json (decoded asset sizes per target), the kernel-bundle budget (100 KB gzip until re-baselined at W7), __TEST_FLAGS__ only in CI builds, and a release gate check that fails if a structure due at that gate still has IMPLEMENTED=false.

00-product/requirements-traceability.md: register the Plotinium ID prefixes SVC- (boot) and DSA-<STRUCT>-nn (GEN, TREE, TRIE, HEAP, DAG, LRU, HASH, RING, BLOOM, ZORD, IVT, DB, MAP) so tools/traceability.ts accepts them.
00-product/identity-and-branding.md: with SVC-08 (device-local), /system/services/*.json need no well-known file ids; your request for fixed ids or server-only seeding still stands for /bin/*.json.

16-delivery/implementation-plan.md: schedule svcmgr v1 and boot-ui v1 truthful progress for W5; boot v2 (menu, modes, degraded state, recovery console, --critical-path, shutdown) by W10; the app start-up DAG in sys.spawn by W7; the DSA implement-by weeks (heap and dag W3; tree, trie, ringbuffer and zorder W5; hashtable W6; lru and bloom W10; interval optional ≤ W13); the non-owner DSA reviewers; one teach-back per structure.
open_questions: Instructor (W4): is 'no timer drives progress' an acceptable reading of Appendix A '0 timers'? The boot UI has exactly two progress-free timers (menu auto-boot countdown and stall watchdog), CI proves neither touches progress, and service timeouts run on the kernel timer heap.

Instructor (W4): is BOOT-10 'cold boot' measured as cold (caches cleared, local state kept) or cold-first (fresh profile, mkfs plus first login)? The spec gates both at 3.0 s on the local stack; the production URL depends on the Lahore RTT.

Team (W5, R5+R2+R3): accept device-local /system/services and /system/log (SVC-08)? Without it, a manifest cycle added on production (the BOOT-04 examiner test) syncs to the server and panics every device, so the test would have to run on the local stack only.
Instructor: is a recovery console without login acceptable, given it can only check, repair or clear the local mirror and reset the local session, and cannot act as any uid?
Team: 5 s boot-menu auto-boot countdown (the spec figure shows 3 s; 5 s chosen for screen-reader users under WCAG 2.2.1, cancelled by any key). Confirm.
Team (P3): after 'reset local cache and re-sync' exports the outbox as JSON, do we also need an 'outbox import' command to replay exported ops?
Instructor (W4): does a radix (compressed) trie satisfy §10.1, given the glossary's 'each edge is a character'? The argument is in data-structures.md §3.5 S2.
Instructor (W4): are interfaces, tests and benchmarks drafted with AI assistance (disclosed in AI_USAGE.md) plus owner-written implementations acceptable under §10.2 and §18?
Team (W5, R3): are sorted sibling lists fast enough for the path namespace on corpora with Urdu or CJK file names, or should the trie use a dsa/hashtable-backed child index from the start?
Team (by W13, R3): build the optional interval tree only if its benchmark beats a linear scan at the supported window counts; otherwise drop it and say so in DSA.md.
Lab machine (W2): re-baseline the boot segment targets, the kernel-bundle budget and the absolute DSA targets on the published reference machine.
